content.title: Acid-Color Type Variant | Adult Action and Graphic Module Relay
content.summary: A set designer walks through acid-pop word modules whose changes are caused by her steps and gestures. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every interface module. + Each module is triggered by one visible body or headphone action and introduces no more than one exact short word. + Waveform, control ring, play bar and fragments remain one coherent graphic system. + Boot and portrait-grid proofs verify the same character before the terminal movement. + The final lockup reunites the adult, settled fragments, recurring rings and one readable original master mark.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open in a white cyclorama on one original clearly adult set designer with a mint bob, amber oval glasses, indigo utility suit and one lime triangle pin beside the exact title "SIGNAL". She lifts the glasses once and one cobalt balloon word "BRIGHT" expands behind her; a lime foreground disc wipes only this transition. Gather the adult, all four color anchors and the lime triangle into one still red lockup reading exactly "SIGNAL / SHIFT BRIGHT"; stop character and graphic motion for the final hold.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every typography module.
Each module introduces at most one exact short word and is triggered by one visible character action.
No module replaces the adult with a different face, age, body or wardrobe identity.
The terminal lockup reunites the complete adult and the original master mark in one readable still frame.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A set designer walks through acid-pop word modules whose changes are caused by her steps and gestures. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一成年时装角色，以发色、服装和眼镜作为身份锚点；巨型立体短词、气球字与图案卡按走动、抬镜和转身逐段切换，最终把人物和完整原创主标汇回同一静止终卡。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every typography module.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity and at least four appearance anchors precede every typography module."

invariants.rule: Each module introduces at most one exact short word and is triggered by one visible character action.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each module introduces at most one exact short word and is triggered by one visible character action."

invariants.rule: Recurring color and shape anchors preserve continuity while typography scale and layout change.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Recurring color and shape anchors preserve continuity while typography scale and layout change."

invariants.rule: No module replaces the adult with a different face, age, body or wardrobe identity.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "No module replaces the adult with a different face, age, body or wardrobe identity."

invariants.rule: The terminal lockup reunites the complete adult and the original master mark in one readable still frame.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal lockup reunites the complete adult and the original master mark in one readable still frame."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
